summary.zh: 东亚秋季红叶的代表，叶掌状深裂。
summary.en: A symbol of East Asian autumn colour, with deeply palmate leaves.

field_marks.zh: 叶对生，掌状 5–9 深裂；翅果成对、两翅近水平张开。
field_marks.en: Opposite palmately lobed leaves with 5–9 lobes; paired winged fruits spread nearly horizontally.

similar.zh: 枫香（Liquidambar）叶互生，果为球形刺球。
similar.en: Sweetgum (Liquidambar) has alternate leaves and spiky round fruits.

story.zh: 按 APG 系统，槭属与无患子、荔枝同科，说明形态相差很大的类群可以是近亲。
story.en: Under APG, maples share a family with soapberry and lychee, showing that very different-looking groups can be close relatives.

notes.zh: 红叶期由北向南推进：日本多在 11 月中旬至下旬（京都约 11 月下旬）。
notes.en: Colour advances from north to south: mid to late November in much of Japan, around late November in Kyoto.
